dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregularly shaped, light-colored ring structures are visible against a darker background. The most prominent 3-5 structures exhibit sharp, jagged outer perimeters with a rapid transition from dark exterior pixels to high-intensity light pixels forming the ring boundaries, which enclose dark internal centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, solid dark clusters located primarily in the interstices between the light rings. These clusters lack internal gradients and are most concentrated in the central-lateral transition zone of the body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal ring structures form a scalene triangle with the widest angle oriented toward the posterior. A series of smaller ring centroids form an irregular polygonal relationship across the mid-lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct, dark, elongated keratinous claws are visible on the distal ends of the digit rays of the hind flipper located at the bottom of the frame.
